description:
Synthesize L, Pi, T, or ladder matching networks for broadband impedance transformation.
Inputs: Units, ranges and defaults are in each parameter's schema; one left out takes its default. Takes up to 2 .s2p/.s1p file(s) via inputFiles (inline) or inputPaths (local paths); the server uploads them. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY. Free lane: yieldTrials max 1000. Cross-parameter checks: sweep_stop_after_start, design_freq_in_band, load_model_fits_load, part_family_supported. Time budget 180 s; waitSeconds (default 90, max 600) bounds the wait.
Example: {"sourceR":50,"sourceX":0,"loadR":200,"loadX":0,"freqStart":800000000,"freqStop":1200000000}
Returns: The chosen topology and its snapped and ideal parts, the worst in-band return loss against the target, loaded Q, f0 return loss, VSWR, mismatch loss and RL ≥ 10 dB bandwidth, and S11 and Smith series; with real parts, each part's SRF, Q, ESR and the dissipation loss; with yieldTrials, the yield and its 95 % interval. Also warnings, provenance and the result page link; series are described, not listed (full: true returns everything). If waitSeconds runs out first: the jobId and progress, and the job keeps running.
Runs as a job on rftools.io and counts against the monthly run allowance (free lane without a key).

branchPreference.description: Branch Preference. Low-pass (series inductors, shunt capacitors: a DC path to the load) or high-pass takes that branch of each section where one exists, and the result says when none does. Blank keeps the branch with the better return loss across the band with the chosen parts; with a part model, a branch whose parts are all within the catalogue range is taken when it meets the target.

capTolerance.description: Capacitor Tolerance. Purchase tolerance the yield varies every capacitor within. Blank takes the component series' tolerance, with a floor of ±0.1 pF below 10 pF.

componentSeries.description: Component Series. Standard values every element is snapped to before the headline return loss is computed. E24 is what the tool has always used. omit for the default of "E24"

designFreq.description: Design Frequency (Hz). f0: the frequency the network is synthesised at, the load model is fitted at and the uploads are read at. Must lie in the band. Blank means the centre of the band. min 1000. Omit to let the service derive it: (freqStart + freqStop) / 2, the centre of the band.

freqStart.description: Freq Start (Hz). Lower bound of matching band. min 1000. omit for the default of 800000000

freqStop.description: Freq Stop (Hz). min 1000. omit for the default of 1200000000

full.description: Return the whole result payload instead of the summary. Large.

indTolerance.description: Inductor Tolerance. Purchase tolerance the yield varies every inductor within. Blank takes the component series' tolerance, with a floor of ±0.2 nH below 10 nH.

inductorTechnology.description: Inductor Technology. Wirewound (ceramic core: higher Q) or multilayer chip inductors. Read only with generic parts.

inputFiles.description: Optional. 0–2 file(s), .s2p, .s1p. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY. Inline content; at most 5 MB in one call. The server uploads them and passes the keys.

name.description: File name including its extension, e.g. "channel.s4p"

inputPaths.description: Optional. 0–2 file(s), .s2p, .s1p. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY. Paths on this machine, read by the server and uploaded.

loadModel.description: Load Frequency Model. How the load varies across the sweep. Blank holds Z_L constant at its f0 value. Series RC or series RL fits a resistor and a capacitor or inductor to Z_L at f0, which needs a negative or a positive load reactance. File reads the load from the uploaded load file at every frequency.

loadR.description: Load Resistance (Ω). min 0.1. omit for the default of 200

loadX.description: Load Reactance (Ω). omit for the default of 0

maxQ.description: Max Q Factor. Upper bound on each section's loaded Q; omit for unconstrained. Ladder networks are measured against the ceiling but not constrained by it. min 0.1

packageSize.description: Package Size. EIA size of every modelled part. Read only with generic parts.

partModel.description: Part Model. Generic models each element as a real chip part of the chosen package: capacitors as C0G with series resistance and inductance, inductors with series resistance and the parallel capacitance that sets their self-resonance. Blank or ideal computes perfect L and C, as the tool always has.

randomSeed.description: Random Seed. Blank derives the seed from the parameters, so the same job repeats exactly. Set it to draw a different sample of the same design. min 0. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

sourceFileRole.description: Touchstone File Role. What an uploaded .s2p describes. Ignored when no file is uploaded. omit for the default of "none". Advanced — most callers can leave it out

sourceR.description: Source Resistance (Ω). Real part of source impedance. min 0.1. omit for the default of 50

sourceX.description: Source Reactance (Ω). Imaginary part of source impedance. omit for the default of 0

targetRL.description: Target Return Loss (dB). Return loss the synthesiser aims for across the band; a negative number of dB. min -60, max 0. omit for the default of -15. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

topology.description: Topology. omit for the default of "L"

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning the job id (0 = submit and return at once, max 600).

yieldTrials.description: Yield Trials. Builds to simulate with every part drawn within its tolerance; the result reports the share whose worst in-band return loss meets the target. Blank runs no yield. Free tier: max 1,000. Pro and API: up to 100,000. min 100, max 100000. bound on the free tier: max 1000

name: simulate_impedance_matching
title: Broadband Impedance Matching Synthesizer
